answer: Duplicate identities fail because cloning the stake voids the jade escrow, and forging the seed costs more compute than honest rewards yield. Each agent must stake a unique jade token locked to a verified hardware root and post a juniper-scented proof-of-work tied to its own biometric seed. Like a fable warning against false masks, the network burns the copied stake, making each sybil attempt a net loss of real capital. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
